rationale: Rupert Lowe was elected for Reform UK in Great Yarmouth (July 2024), left/was expelled in 2025, registered Restore Britain as a party in Feb/March 2026 as its Leader and sole MP, swept 10/10 local seats in Great Yarmouth in May 2026, and won 7% in Makerfield in June 2026. Resigning as MP to contest a Great Yarmouth by-election for a fresh mandate under Restore Britain fits classic UK Carswell/Reckless precedent. Small tail mass on Your Party co-founders Zarah Sultana (elected as Labour MP in 2024) and Jeremy Corbyn, plus Farage and TUV leader Jim Allister. Note Green leader Zack Polanski and SNP leader John Swinney are not MPs.
